metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented all four actions in `output/`, using only the C++20 standard library.

```sh
cd output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
./build/gedcom_tool --input request.json --output response.json
```

Verified: 1,345 C++ checks, 549 interoperability checks, and sanitizer tests passed.

Usage and supported formats are documented in [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md).

editorial.last_message: Completed GEDCOM/GEDZIP implementation; unchanged source scores 212/212 under GEDCOM 4.0.3. The VOID fixture correction recovers its sole previous failure.
editorial.notes: The C++20 implementation uses only its own modules and the standard library. Transcript evidence includes successful final 1,345 C++ checks, 549 Python ZIP interoperability checks, and address/undefined-behavior sanitizer checks. Initial schema extraction and pointer-type parsing errors were corrected before the final build. Original 4.0.2 score is 211/212. Source gedcom.cpp accepts @VOID@ itself, but its extra INDI.FAMS-to-partner check rejects the old VOID fixture after that fixture retains the former partner link. The isolated 4.0.3 fixture removes this unrelated interpretation and requires exact decoded WIFE @VOID@; the unchanged source then passes 212/212. This is the sole common-node change. Public §3.2.2 explicitly requires family-to-individual backlinks; the converse partner interpretation is left for public clarification. A documented local nesting limit of 1,024 is outside these test observations, so a full suite score is not an exhaustive conformance claim. Both generation and grading completed voluntarily, with no quota/authentication/disconnection interruption. Full transcript and authored implementation reviewed. Requested gpt-6-astra with max reasoning is corroborated by the session; served_model remains unknown/null. Launch used CLI 0.153.4 with hosted apps explicitly disabled and web search disabled. External-tool audit found no MCP, hosted-app or web-search invocations, with no verification problems. API-only proxy logs show only allowed chatgpt.com API access; nine denied non-API attempts did not gain access. Saved token, cache, reasoning and underlying-tool counts exactly match reparsed preserved events/session; no usage correction is required. Launch and completion revisions differ, but the audited invocation files are byte-identical. Original artifacts remain unchanged.  Official 4.0.3 regrade now confirms 212/212 and matches every isolated candidate outcome. The exact underlying-tool total remains 48. All token, cached-input and reasoning totals, generation cost and original metadata remain exact. Source, raw result, transcript, richer session and network artifacts are unchanged. No new model call or model cost was incurred. Actual generation comparison cohort: api-only-apps-disabled; apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed. Requested model/effort are corroborated by preserved session evidence; served identity remains unknown/null.
